verdict.rationale: Mirrors captures production traces and compares sessions that received a correction against holdout groups. It does this using outcome labels and checks the team defines and tracks itself, and its own docs position evals as a separate concern handled by tools like Langfuse, LangSmith and Braintrust. Nothing in the pack shows Mirrors running evaluators continuously on live traffic. The holdout outcome comparison and the 'checks passed' UI snippet are adjacent features, not a documented online-evaluation capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets
